versions.content: If frames with a payload <= 8 (either CAN 2.0 frames or small CAN FD frames) are used for a Tx N - SDU and if CanTpTxPaddingActivation is equal to CANTP_ON , CanTp shall transmit by means of CanIf_Transmit() call, SF Tx N - PDU or last CF T x N - PDU that belongs to that Tx N - SDU with the length of eight bytes(i.e. PduInfoPtr.SduLength = 8). Unused bytes in N - PDU shall be updated with CANTP_PADDING_BYTE (see ECUC_CanTp_00298 ) .
